note: A deliberately bad draft, written to break the style guide: a generic sci-fi voice, a long dash, numbers, a spelled-out swap trick, a crew and a boss, a shiny station and a rude line. The loop must find and fix every one on its own.
lines: Captain, this freighter's hyperdrive is shot — leaving now costs you 250 credits, so just take the 65% engine from the fighter and drop it into the freighter instead.
Our crew of mechanics keeps these gleaming new bays spotless, and the boss says we never cut corners on a job.
Release it if you want, genius. I'll slap a part in and you'll pay through the nose.
